settings @{
  randomSeed: "fd01a0a318bb5502541547e1afef2db9",
  viewport: @{ xmin: -9, xmax: 9, ymin: -5, ymax: 5 },
  xAxisMinorSubdivisions: 1,
  yAxisMinorSubdivisions: 1,
  squareAxes: false,
}

ticker R_un, L_ogFPS({dt < 200: dt, 200} / 1000) @{ minStep: 50 }

"^\n \\\n  \\\nPlay the ticker to turn on the game\nPlease play fullscreen!\n\n\n\n\n\nInstructions:\n    Press \"Burn\" to engage rockets\n    Spam \"Burn\" to move faster, but use more fuel\n    Use the zoom buttons (+/-) to change your viewport size\n    The \"Reset Lander\" button can be used to recover your lander from the starting point after a landing\n    Press \"New Game\" to start over\n    Use the injector scale to control the amount of fuel each burn uses up\n\nRules:\n    Don't crash! If either of your lander legs touch the moon's surface too hard, the lander will explode!\n    Soft landings (Velocity <= 10) gain you 10 points\n    Hard landings (Velocity <= 20) gain you 5 points\n    Landings at Velocity > 20 or Angle > 25 (relative to the ground) will cause you to crash!\n    After every landing, you can press \"Reset Lander\" to respawn at the top, for another landing opportunity\n    See how many points you can gain before your fuel runs out!\n\n\n\n\n\n| 2026-10-07 - 2026-10-10 | jonahcrawford.com | github.com/Jonah-Crawford | CRAW SYSTEMS | Made By Jonah Crawford (@The_Craw) for the \"Wrong Tool\" event during Stardance, hosted by Hack Club | https://github.com/Jonah-Crawford/Lunar-Lander-in-Desmos"

folder "Functions" {
  "Conversion error: R_{otateLander}\\left(x,y,\\theta\\right)=\\left(\\left(P_{osX}+\\left(x-P_{osX}\\right)\\cos\\left(\\theta\\right)-\\left(y-P_{osY}\\right)\\sin\\left(\\theta\\right)\\right),\\left(P_{osY}+\\left(x-P_{osX}\\right)\\sin\\left(\\theta\\right)+\\left(y-P_{osY}\\right)\\cos\\left(\\theta\\right)\\right)\\right)"

  "Conversion error: R_{otate}\\left(x,y,\\theta\\right)=\\left(\\left(P_{osX}+\\left(x-P_{osX}\\right)\\cos\\left(\\theta\\right)-\\left(y-P_{osY}\\right)\\sin\\left(\\theta\\right)\\right),\\left(P_{osY}+\\left(x-P_{osX}\\right)\\sin\\left(\\theta\\right)+\\left(y-P_{osY}\\right)\\cos\\left(\\theta\\right)\\right)\\right)"

  A_nchor(x, y) = (x + P_osX, y + P_osY) @{ color: "#000000" }

  C_lamp(x, n) = {x > n: n, x} @{ color: "#6042a6" }

  N_egligible(a) = {|a| < 0.001: 0, a} @{ color: "#388c46", hidden: true }

  C_X(x) = P_osX + Z_oom(x - P_osX) @{ color: "#c74440", hidden: true }

  C_Y(x) = P_osY + Z_oom(x - P_osY) @{ color: "#c74440", hidden: true }

  c_X(x) = P_osX + (x - P_osX) / Z_oom @{ color: "#2d70b3", hidden: true }

  c_Y(x) = P_osY + (x - P_osY) / Z_oom @{ color: "#2d70b3", hidden: true }

  N_ot(a) = {a = 0: 1, 0} @{ color: "#2d70b3", hidden: true }

  A_nd(a, b) = {a + b = 2: 1, 0} @{ color: "#388c46" }

  A_nd3(a, b, c) = {a + b + c = 3: 1, 0} @{ color: "#2d70b3" }

  O_r(a, b) = {a + b > 0: 1, 0} @{ color: "#000000" }

  O_r4(a, b, c, d) = {a + b + c + d > 0: 1, 0} @{ color: "#000000" }

  P_ositive(a) = {a > 0: 1, 0} @{ color: "#c74440", hidden: true }

  E_qual(a, b) = {a = b: 1, 0} @{ color: "#6042a6" }

  M_ux(a, b, i) = {i = 0: a, b} @{ color: "#000000" }

  "Conversion error: S_{houldRender}\\left(l\\right)=\\left\\{l\\left[1\\right]=1:1,\\sum_{n=1}^{\\operatorname{length}\\left(l\\right)}\\left(l\\left[n\\right]\\right)>1:1,0\\right\\}"

  T_hrustSmoothing(t, T) = 0.8 @{ color: "#6042a6" }

  N_anCheck(a) = {a = a: 0, 1} @{ color: "#2d70b3", hidden: true }
} @{ collapsed: true }

folder "Collision Detection" {
  G_etLandingMode(v, delta) =
    {
      v <= L_andingSoftMaxV: max(3 * C_heckHardA(delta), 1),
      v > L_andingHardMaxV: 1,
      max(2 * C_heckHardA(delta), 1)
    } @{ color: "#c74440", hidden: true }

  C_heckHardA(delta) = {|delta| < L_andingHardMaxA: 1, 0} @{
    color: "#000000",
    hidden: true,
  }

  C_heckCrashA(delta) = {|delta| > L_andingHardMaxA: 1, 0} @{
    color: "#000000",
    hidden: true,
  }

  C_heckSoft(c) = {c = 3: 1, 0} @{ color: "#000000", hidden: true }

  C_heckHard(c) = {c = 2: 1, 0} @{ color: "#000000", hidden: true }

  C_heckCrash(c) = {c = 1: 1, 0} @{ color: "#000000", hidden: true }

  "Conversion error: L_{eftAltitude}=\\left(P_{osY}-Z_{oom}\\left(L_{unarGoldSize}+L_{unarGoldOffset}\\right)\\right)-\\left(T_{errainFunction}\\left(P_{osX}-Z_{oom}\\left(L_{unarGoldSize}+L_{unarGoldOffset}\\right)\\right)\\right)"

  "Conversion error: R_{ightAltitude}=\\left(P_{osY}-Z_{oom}\\left(L_{unarGoldSize}+L_{unarGoldOffset}\\right)\\right)-\\left(T_{errainFunction}\\left(P_{osX}+Z_{oom}\\left(L_{unarGoldSize}+L_{unarGoldOffset}\\right)\\right)\\right)"

  "Conversion error: G_{X1}=P_{osX}-\\left(L_{unarGoldSize}+L_{unarGoldOffset}\\right)Z_{oom}"

  G_Y1 = T_errainFunction(P_osX - Z_oom(L_unarGoldSize + L_unarGoldOffset)) @{
    color: "#c74440",
  }

  "Conversion error: G_{X2}=P_{osX}+\\left(L_{unarGoldSize}+L_{unarGoldOffset}\\right)Z_{oom}"

  G_Y2 = T_errainFunction(P_osX + Z_oom(L_unarGoldSize + L_unarGoldOffset)) @{
    color: "#c74440",
  }

  G_roundGradient = (G_Y2 - G_Y1) / (G_X2 - G_X1) @{ color: "#c74440" }

  gamma = arctan(G_roundGradient) @{ color: "#6042a6" }

  "Conversion error: \\Delta=\\frac{180\\left(\\gamma-\\alpha\\right)}{\\pi}"

  R_un @{ color: "#388c46" }

  V_elocity = 25 @{
    color: "#388c46",
    hidden: true,
    slider: @{ loopMode: "PLAY_INDEFINITELY" },
  }

  G_etLandingMode(V_elocity, Delta) @{ color: "#6042a6" }

  V_elList @{ color: "#c74440" }

  R_esetCollision = C_ollision -> 0, C_ollisionType -> 0 @{ color: "#6042a6" }

  R_unning = 1 @{
    color: "#6042a6",
    hidden: true,
    slider: @{ min: 0, max: 1, step: 1 },
  }

  C_ollision = 0 @{ color: "#2d70b3", slider: @{ min: 0, max: 1, step: 1 } }

  C_ollisionType = 0 @{
    color: "#388c46",
    hidden: true,
    slider: @{ min: 0, max: 3, step: 1 },
  }

  D_ead @{ color: "#388c46" }
} @{ collapsed: true }

folder "Background" {
  x <= x + 1 @{ color: B_lack, lines: @{ width: 0 }, fill: 1 }

  S_tarList =
    [
      (
        P_osX +
          Z_oom(
            ((2 * C_ameraScaleX) / Z_oomMin) * random() -
              C_ameraScaleX / Z_oomMin
          ),
        P_osY +
          Z_oom(
            ((2 * C_ameraScaleY) / Z_oomMin) * random() -
              C_ameraScaleY / Z_oomMin
          )
      ) for i = [1 ... 50]
    ] @{ color: W_hite, hidden: true, points: @{ size: 2, drag: "NONE" } }

  "Conversion error: \\left(x-S_{tarList}.x\\right)^{2}+1.1\\left(y-S_{tarList}.y\\right)^{2}=0.01^{2}"
} @{ collapsed: true }
